news.headline: Sterling Brokers Acquires Lucite, Bringing AI and Enterprise-Grade Tools to Canada’s Independent Benefits Brokers
news.summary: TORONTO, November 06, 2026--Sterling Brokers, a Canadian employee benefits brokerage, today announced its acquisition of Lucite, an AI platform that helps benefits brokers analyze data, automate workflows and deliver improved service to clients. The acquisition expands Sterling’s reach beyond its own brokerage, bringing technology and administration services to independent brokers across Canada.
